jobs.description: About the job Our purpose is to bring hope to life by enabling life-changing therapies for patients around the globe, creating a healthier and happier tomorrow. Our mission is to work side by side with our customers to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market. Are you a detail-oriented student who thrives on organizing information and supporting technical teams? Do you want hands-on experience in a fast-paced biopharmaceutical environment? Then join AGC Biologics as a Student Assistant in our Equipment Maintenance and Calibration team—where your work helps map and optimize our cutting-edge production facilities. At AGC Biologics, you’ll join a fast-growing biopharmaceutical company where quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. As Student Assistant in our Equipment Maintenance and Calibration team, you’ll play a key role in organizing information, analysing data, mapping our facilities, and supporting the team while they keep our production and utility systems running at top performance—supporting life-changing treatments for patients worldwide. About the Team The Equipment Maintenance and Calibration team in Engineering comprises of dedicated technicians, engineers, and coordinators with a strong focus on personal development, collaboration, and high professional standards. We operate with a flat structure where every contribution matters and decisions are made collaboratively. Our culture emphasizes ownership, continuous learning, and mutual support. We work closely together to maintain critical production equipment and promote a safe, innovative, and engaging work environment. About the Role As a Student Assistant in our Equipment Maintenance and Calibration team, you will be primarily responsible for: Support the day-to-day operations of the Equipment Maintenance and Calibration team (e.g., data entry, document control, coordinating small tasks) Lead the facility mapping initiative by collecting and verifying the Process and Instrumentation Drawings (PIDs), building layouts, electrical and utility drawings, service and maintenance agreements, and spare-parts inventories, etc. Consolidate information into our CMMS or a central digital repository, ensuring accuracy and ease of access for the team Assist in updating and maintaining equipment records, location tags, and asset lists Collaborate with technicians and engineers to clarify technical details and resolve gaps in documentation Contribute ideas for improving our documentation processes and data workflows Analyze facility data (drawings, service agreements, spare-parts inventories, etc.) to identify gaps, validate completeness and produce clear, data-driven reports that guide maintenance planning and process improvements. This role offers flexible hours to accommodate your study schedule and the possibility of a longer-term internship if desired. Your Qualifications We are looking for a candidate who: Is enrolled in a relevant technical or engineering program (e.g., mechanical, electrical, industrial engineering, etc.), preferably in the first year of your education Demonstrates strong organizational skills and a keen eye for detail Has excellent communication skills in English and preferably Danish, both written and verbal Is proficient with Microsoft Office (Excel, Visio, Power BI) and eager to learn CMMS tools or CAD basics Is self-motivated, reliable, and able to work independently as well as part of a team What We Offer This role will give you insight into the design and operation of biopharmaceutical production facilities, as well as how the various departments collaborate to deliver life-changing therapies. On top of that, we offer the following: Meaningful tasks that directly support our maintenance operations and facility improvements Mentoring from experienced technicians and engineers Flexible scheduling to balance work and studies A collaborative, supportive work culture in a leading biopharmaceutical company How to Apply Applications are screened on an ongoing basis. You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about your motivation for applying to this position. If this sounds like the right challenge for you, we’d love to hear from you. Don’t hesitate to apply – even if you don’t meet every single requirement. The right mindset matters just as much. If we see a potential match, one of our recruiters will contact you to discuss your application. If you have any questions, please contact Sameer Ahmed (Senior Manager, Equipment Maintenance and Calibration) on +45 50106391 or on LinkedIn. Who We Are AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market. AGC Biologics is Your Friendly CDMO Expert – dedicated partners with the expertise and commitment to support our customers and teams. We work with some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies to develop and manufacture their life-changing drug products. If you’re motivated by meaningful impact and ready to join our journey, we invite you to explore our current opportunities!

SOUNDBOKS is an innovative tech company and aspiring lifestyle brand. You may have seen us at a music festival, street party, or your friend’s celebration (think: private events combining festival-grade sound with beat-enhancing lights) where special moments are turned into memories. We create the loudest, most durable, and arguably coolest Bluetooth speakers and audio reactive lights on the market.

At SOUNDBOKS, trust and community go hand in hand. People are encouraged to take ownership of their work while knowing they have the support of the team behind them. Voices are heard, ideas are welcomed, and collaboration is what pushes us forward.

This is more than a job - it’s a community where people care about each other, celebrate together, and share the energy of creating something meaningful. Life at SOUNDBOKS is bold, fast, and full of passion - for the product, for the mission, and for showing up as your true self. With 70 team members, this is a place where you can do your best work and truly belong.

ROLE ACOUSTIC ENGINEER

TEAM PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

HOURS FULL TIME

LOCATION COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

START DATE OCTOBER 2026 or ASAP

The Product Development team at SOUNDBOKS is the group responsible for the exciting product journey, taking every step of the development process toward and into mass production. In it’s heartbeat you’ll find collaborative and self-driven team members with a large cross-discipline understanding tied to ownership. They are there to make a difference - for the products, the team and the SOUNDBOKS customers as a whole.

Every SOUNDBOKS starts with a great idea - but turning it into a speaker that can survive a festival, run for hours, and sound incredible takes a lot of engineering. As the Acoustic Engineer, you'll be taking charge of the acoustic development that helps bring those products to life.

Okay, let’s make things a little more concrete. Here’s what we expect your daily life to look like:

**Concept & Prototype Development

**

• You'll select and design acoustic components based on product and market requirements.

• You'll define initial enclosure concepts.

• You'll build and evaluate proof-of-concept prototypes to validate acoustic concepts.

• You'll collaborate with Mechanical Engineering during the early product development phase to mature acoustic concepts.

**Simulation & Validation

**

• You'll perform acoustic simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• You'll validate simulation results through physical testing.

• You'll collaborate with suppliers to refine acoustic components based on simulation and test results.

**Driver Specification & Verification

**

• You'll own the technical specification of loudspeaker drivers towards suppliers.

• You'll define driver specifications and tolerances.

• You'll support manufacturing verification with suppliers.

• You'll participate in the acoustic verification of the final product towards mass production.

• You'll collaborate with the Audio team on audio signal handling, including crossovers, compressors, and limiters.

**In order to become a success in this role, we believe that your profile should be aligned with the bullets listed below. However, we acknowledge that success can take many forms, so please do apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

**

• You have proven experience designing and simulating loudspeakers, including transducer design and specification, enclosure design, and acoustic measurements.

• You hold a BSc or higher in Audio, Acoustics, Mechanical, or a related engineering discipline.

• You've done loudspeaker simulation and measurements, and use both to validate and refine your designs.

• You've worked with loudspeaker development from concept through verification and ideally have experience collaborating with external manufacturing partners.

• Familiarity with crossover design, FEM simulations, or failure analysis is an advantage.

• Ideally you also have experience building physical speaker mock-ups or collaborating with large-scale loudspeaker manufacturing partners.

• You work independently, take ownership of your area, and enjoy collaborating closely with engineers across disciplines.

• You're curious, creative, and constantly looking for ways to improve acoustic performance.

• You're drawn to what SOUNDBOKS is building and are excited to be a part of the journey!

Intrigued? At SOUNDBOKS you’ll find yourself a part of a community. We realize that growth is a process and we don’t expect you to go through it alone. Actually, we guarantee that you won’t have to. We work together in order to work smarter, we inspire each other to be better, and we never forget that every member of the team is responsible for our success.

So, if you’re tired of all of the noise in the job market, we’d love to hear from you. This may be the coolest job you ever have!

jobs.occupation: Design for Value & Cost Engineer – from concept to competitive edge, GN Hearing, Ballerup
jobs.description:
Are you ready to apply your engineering, project leadership and sourcing expertise to the world of product development and manufacturing? Join us as Senior Project Manager in Design for Value (DfV) and impact the way we design, develop, and manufacture products at GN Hearing in Ballerup.

The team you will be part of:

Based at our global HQ, located in Ballerup, Denmark, you will join the Design for Value team in Global Manufacturing & Operations, reporting directly to Director René Bergqvist.

In this role, you will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders worldwide, ensuring value and cost are managed effectively and optimized in our products from the early concept phase through to mass production.

Your contribution is appreciated and you will:

• Optimize products by supporting the organization with cost / value analysis in our products, modules, platforms and architecture

• Investigate and motivate for cost-effective design and manufacturability, e.g. via mapping of value / cost opportunities related to roadmap, product, and design options

• Manage cost targets and running estimate for ramp up in development projects

• Facilitate and support project sourcing activities including availability reviews, supplier selection, RFQs, and negotiations

• Support building positive business cases together with R&D & Product Marketing

• Facilitate and conduct project reviews related to Design for Value, Cost and Manufacturing

• Follow up and guard the cost in product development by working with R&D on their suggested specification, manufacturing or material selection

You will also work on introducing new technologies and innovations during product development and play a key role in approving targets and results before critical milestones are passed.

You will also support key cross-functional projects that are part of strategic initiatives (“must-win battles”) with significant value or savings impact from an Operations and Sourcing perspective.

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you - besides having a technical mindset and a good business understanding - have:

• A degree or similar within engineering, preferably within electronics

• Experience within platform and product development, supplier sourcing or cost/value optimization in a R&D environment are positive differentiators

• Good at solving both technical and commercial issues

• General understanding of manufacturing processes and industrialization

• Experience with LEAN, Design for Value/Cost, or supplier sourcing in Asia, are positive differentiators

• Presentation, negotiation, and communication skills in English, both written and spoken

In addition, you have an engaging personality and possess facilitation skills, enabling you to build networks and engage stakeholders. You also possess solid analytical and problem-solving abilities, which you use to identify issues and propose effective solutions.

You are, furthermore, steadfast and enjoy working in a multicultural, changing environment. You take initiative and, most importantly, follow through on the initiatives you start.

We offer:

• A unique opportunity to grow and gain experience across both engineering and business

• A supportive and dynamic work environment where you can learn to navigate change with confidence

• Opportunities for professional and personal growth in a top-tier global high-tech company.

• The chance to contribute meaningfully to GN

• An international and collaborative workplace

We encourage you to apply

We highly value a mindset, motivation, and energy, that align with our core values, to not only ensure your growth, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the Interview please let the hiring manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.

How to apply?

Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 25 November 2026. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

Join us in bringing people closer

GN brings people closer through our leading intelligent hearing, inspired by people and driven by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We help people with hearing loss overcome real-life challenges, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.

GN has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

Are you passionate about delivering great customer experiences and solving technical challenges?

At Trackman, we are looking for a service-minded and technically curious Customer Service Specialist to join our Business Tools Support team.

In this role, you will be a key point of contact for customers worldwide, helping them get the most out of our innovative sports technology. From troubleshooting technical issues to guiding new customers through onboarding, you will play an important role in delivering a seamless and professional customer experience.

You will join an international and collaborative environment where customer satisfaction, problem-solving, and continuous improvement are at the heart of what we do.

Meet the Team

You will join our Business Tools Support team in EMEA, a collaborative team of six supporting the digital platforms and services used by Trackman venues worldwide, including Booking & Payments, the Trackman Portal, and venue onboarding.

Working closely with customers, Sales, Product, and Development, the team resolves technical and operational challenges and continuously improves our solutions. You will have the opportunity to develop your technical knowledge, support international customers, and contribute to delivering excellent customer experiences.

What will you be doing?

As a Customer Service Specialist, you will combine customer service with hands-on technical support. Your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone and email, providing professional, friendly, and efficient assistance.

• 
Technical Troubleshooting: Identify, diagnose, and resolve technical issues related to Trackman products, software, and connected devices.

• 
Customer Onboarding: Guide new customers through product setup, configuration, and usage, ensuring they feel confident using our solutions.

• 
Product Guidance: Educate customers on product features, updates, and best practices to help them get the most out of Trackman technology.

• 
Case Management: Handle multiple support requests, prioritize effectively, and maintain accurate documentation in our support system.

• 
Follow-up & Customer Satisfaction: Proactively follow up on customer cases to ensure successful resolutions and positive experiences.

• 
Collaboration & Improvement: Work closely with colleagues and other departments to resolve complex issues, share knowledge, and continuously improve our support processes.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who enjoys helping people, has a natural interest in technology, and thrives in a dynamic, international environment.

Ideally, you bring:

• 
Previous experience in customer service, technical support, or a similar customer-facing role, preferably within a technology-related industry.

• 
Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

• 
A customer-focused mindset with excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.

• 
Confidence working with Windows operating systems, computers, and common technical devices such as monitors, projectors, and mobile devices.

• 
Experience with ticketing or customer support systems, preferably Zendesk.

• 
The ability to manage multiple requests, prioritize tasks, and maintain a high level of service in a busy environment.

• 
A proactive, structured, and collaborative approach to your work.

It would be an advantage if you also have:

• 
An interest in sports, particularly golf, baseball, or sports technology.

• 
Basic knowledge of networking and connectivity.

• 
Experience with remote troubleshooting and technical diagnostics.

• 
Additional education or training in IT, customer service, or a related field.

• 
Flexibility to work weekends when required.

Most importantly, you are curious, eager to learn, and motivated by making a difference for customers.

What can we offer?

At Trackman, you will become part of an international technology company where innovation, sports, and passion come together.

You will have the opportunity to work with advanced sports technology used by athletes, coaches, and organizations worldwide, alongside talented and dedicated colleagues.

We offer a collaborative working environment, opportunities to develop your technical and customer service skills, and a culture where initiative, ownership, and new ideas are valued.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

If you are excited about combining technology, customer service, and sports, we would love to hear from you!

For additional information about the position, please contact Jade Palphreyman, Business Tools Lead EMEA, at japa@trackman.com.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**The Senior Manager, Biostatistics acts as a biostatistician supporting the clinical development of compounds as compound lead, primarily up until proof of concept, and/or as trial responsible statistician.

**Responsibilities

**Compound/Indication Level

• Act as lead and main point of contact related to Statistics for designated compound/indication

• Follow scientific and technical progress within the field of biostatistics in drug development and advise of new methodologies that may support innovation and improve efficiencies

• Engage with regulatory authorities on compound/indication level discussions

• Acts as a role model

• Ensures consistency of statistical methods and data handling across trials

• Ensures all compound/indication related work and information is shared between biostatisticians involved in the compound and with the vendor

• Supports compound responsible programmer in developing an integrated database specification

**CDT Member

**

• Responsible for giving statistical input to overall strategy and the synopsis development in the CDT

• Provide scientific advice to the CDT including design of trials, analyses and analyses requiring advanced statistical methodologies/techniques

• Represent the CDT/the company at regulatory meetings, during Key Opinion Leaders meetings, network and/or Partner meetings, as applicable

• Drive design and synopsis development together with relevant stakeholders

• Ensure transparent communication to relevant stakeholders from the CDT

• Ensure availability of integrated database(s), as needed, and planning and conduct of integrated analysis to support development decisions, submissions, and marketing needs

• Support development and communication in relation to communication strategy and/or scientific input to presentations, posters, and articles

Trial Level

• Represent Genmab during meetings/congresses and courses and perform professional networking

• Engage with regulatory authorities on trial level discussions

• Arranges/attends lessons learned to share learnings

• Represents Genmab during Key Opinion Leaders meetings

• Ensure biostatistician review of partner synopsis, protocols, statistical analysis plans, results meetings presentations and clinical trial reports

• Coordinate data transfers from/to business partners in collaboration with the programmer and the data manager, as applicable

**CTT Member

**

• Participate and represent Biostatistics

• Review and provide input to protocol and amendment development

• Perform vendor oversight according to applicable SOPs

• Give input to eCRF setup, edit checks, validation plan, protocol deviations classifications, DSUR, IB updates, tables, figures, and listings etc.

• Review assay validation reports, as applicable

• Perform exploratory analysis, ad hoc analyses, and modelling of data

• Review and approve randomization and stratification plans

• Perform UAT of Randomization part of the IRT system as applicable

• Ensure procedures for blinding are in place as applicable

• Support timely delivery of statistical deliverables

• Responsible for planning and conducting trial result meetings

• Review and approve the CSR

• Attend operational and steering committee meetings, as applicable

• Support regulatory submission/filing activities

**Requirements

**

• MS / PhD or equivalent in a statistical discipline

• 5+ years of experience in relevant area preferred or demonstrated capability

• Experience in statistical analysis, modelling and simulation and adaptive trial designs

• Experience in working with clinical trials

• Preferred experience with oncology clinical trials

• Proficient programming skills in statistical software’s, such as SAS

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Ability to work independently as well as in teams

• Confident, self-reliant, and a quick learner

• Proactive and open-minded

• Ability to prioritize and work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Result and goal-oriented and committed to contributing to the overall success of Genmab

For US based candidates, the proposed salary band for this position is as follows:

$130,560.00---$195,840.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

• Voluntary Plans: Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance

• Time Off: Paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and 12 weeks of discretionary paid parental leave

• Support Resources: Access to child and adult backup care, family support programs, financial wellness tools, and emotional well-being support

• Additional Perks: Commuter benefits, tuition reimbursement, and a Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness and personal expenses

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on role will be provided during the recruitment process

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Job Description

This role is based in Taastrup, Denmark, and requires strong on-site presence in the data center environment. We are only open to applicants already based in Denmark

Due to security clearance requirements, you must be able to document that you have lived and worked in an EU or NATO country for the past 7 years and we are not able to offer work visa support or sponsorship for this role

Are you an expert in ensuring uptime and high quality in a Data Center, or would you like to become one? Then here is a unique opportunity to oversee the operation and maintenance of multiple data centers!

If you have the following, this job is for you:

• Technical education: It can be as a marine engineer, electrician, refrigeration technician, energy technologist, automation technologist or similar

• Relevant experience with Critical Facilities: e.g., Electrical, mechanical, generators, automation, HVAC, buildings automation etc.

• Practical experience with troubleshooting and servicing technical installations

• Experience from operations in a technical environment - preferably data centers

• Meeting customer and government security screening requirements are required for this role

About the role and the team

GlobalConnect operates 11 data centers in Denmark and even more in the other countries where GlobalConnect is present. In addition to the ongoing operation and maintenance of our existing Data centers, there are also large expansions in the pipeline. As our new Data Center Critical Facilities Engineer, you will be part of the Site Operations department with over 45 skilled team members, with colleagues in Norway, Finland, Sweden, Denmark and Germany and with employees from many nationalities, enabling you to work in a multinational environment.

Site Operations Denmark is a workplace with focus on a good working environment. We focus on professional and personal well-being and emphasize good working relationships. Through your work as a Critical Facilities, you will have the chance to engage with every facet of managing a data center. You will experience flexibility in relation to your everyday life and a large degree of freedom under responsibility. You can also expect that most days you will be met with exciting projects and tasks that ensures no workdays are the same.

Moreover, you will have an important role being an essential part of the rotational 24x7 on-call system, also having the requirement to work overtime, reflecting the continuous nature of data center operations as a Data Center never sleeps. Based on these requirements, it would therefore also be beneficial if you are able to reach our Taastrup site within approx. 45 minutes.

Key Responsibilities and what you will do during a typical week:

• Preventive & Corrective Maintenance: Perform rounds and inspections to conduct preventive and corrective maintenance on critical systems. Inspect and test important equipment such as backup generators, cooling systems, UPS batteries, and electrical panels to ensure optimal performance and early detection of faults.

• Physical Monitoring & Inspections: Carry out daily inspections on infrastructure components to assess technical performance, environmental conditions, and compliance with safety and operational standards.

• Incident & Emergency Response: Monitor and respond rapidly to system alerts, alarms, and emergencies.

• Complex Problem Solving: Troubleshoot and assist with repairing of complex issues across electrical, mechanical, and control systems. Apply systematic problem-solving techniques and escalate when needed.

• Change Management: Support the execution and documentation of system changes, following established Change Management protocols to minimize operational risk.

• Vendor Supervision: Coordinate and supervise external vendors to ensure adherence to operational procedures, safety requirements, and quality standards during maintenance or installation work.

Who we are looking for

You are a dedicated professional with a strong commitment to operational excellence and safety in Mission critical environments. With a blend of technical knowledge and hands-on experience, you are skilled at handling complex systems and processes and thrive in roles where critical infrastructure demands unwavering attention. You are detail-oriented, quick to respond to emergencies, and focused on developing and adhering to robust procedures. Your adaptability and communication skills enable you to work effectively with team members, vendors, and contractors alike.

Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you

Recruitment & interview process steps

• Talent Acquisition Screen

• Hiring Manager interview

• Personality and ability tests feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition

We are looking for a Financial Controller to lead the operational and analytical work behind our monthly close, group consolidation, project controlling and control environment of a fast-growing energy trading and technology group – and to rebuild them AI-first, so our numbers are faster, more reliable and ready for scale.

Why this role matters

Hybrid Greentech is scaling fast as a VPP, BRP and electricity retailer across Denmark, and Northern Europe. Energy trading means large and volatile daily revenue, cost and cash transactions – so quality , accuracy and liquidity control are not back-office topics; they decide how fast we can grow. This role exists to give management, the board and investors numbers they can trust, on time, and to build controls and automation that scale with the business rather than with headcount. The same discipline is needed in our consultancy arm, where technical consultants deliver advisory and EPC management projects: clear project economics, timely invoicing and early warning when a project drifts.

The role

As Financial Controller, you report to our Finance Manager and work closely with the CFO and our accountant in a small, hands-on finance team. You lead the operational and analytical work within the financial steering, reporting and finance and business analytics; running the month-end close, the consolidation of our group entities in Denmark and abroad, balance sheet reconciliations, project controlling and the day-to-day operation of our internal controls. This is an individual contributor role with high ownership and direct visibility towards management.

You will work in close collaboration with our settlement team, project managers and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting, partner with our accountant on more complex accounting topics, and work across trading, portfolio management, commercial and engineering. We are a tech-first company with high AI adoption, and we expect you to work that way too: AI tools, scripting and automation are your default approach to removing manual work from close, reconciliation and reporting – combined with the judgement to know when a number needs a human review.

**What you will do

**

• Lead and execute the monthly close and group consolidation, including account mapping, intercompany eliminations, reconciliations and variance analysis, and prepare the monthly financial and business review for the CFO, management and the board.

• Set up and run project controlling – project budgets, hours and utilisation, work in progress, milestone and fixed-fee revenue recognition and timely invoicing – giving project managers and business owners clear steering on margin, estimate-to-complete and cash.

• Automate and rebuild our reporting flow – from ERP trial balances to consolidated P&L, balance sheet and cash flow – using AI tools, scripting and data pipelines, replacing manual spreadsheet steps with controlled, repeatable and documented processes.

• Operate and strengthen our internal controls within the framework set by the Finance Manager, including segregation of duties, payment and bank authorisations and documented business procedures, and drive follow-up on auditor recommendations.

• In close collaboration with Settlement, ensure trading-related balances – settlement, imbalance costs, customer prepayments and deposits, and collateral posted to TSOs, DSOs and exchanges – are correctly recognized, invoiced and reconciled

• Support cash and liquidity forecasting and management with the Finance Manager and CFO, including rolling cash forecasts, collateral and trading risk capital tracking, and early warning on cash exposure.

• Prepare and analyse the annual budget and monthly forecast updates for the Finance Manager and CFO, maintaining our driver-based budget model and following up on budget-versus-actual deviations with business owners.

• Handle key accounting areas such as revenue recognition and accruals, capitalisation of development projects, grant periodisation and month-end cost accruals, collaborating with our accountant on more complex accounting topics.

• Support in the year-end close and audit for all group entities, including annual reports, tax specifications and intercompany agreements, in close collaboration with Finance Manager and our external auditors.

• Work closely with our Settlement team and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting – turning data into insight on gross profit by revenue stream, cost of execution and unit economics, and building dashboards that let the business self-serve.

**

What you bring**

_Experience and skills (Required)

_

• 5+ years of experience as a controller, in audit or in a group finance role, ideally in a multi-entity set-up.

• A relevant degree in accounting, finance or economics (e.g. cand.merc., HD-R or cand.merc.aud.).

• Proven hands-on experience running month-end close, consolidation and year-end audit under the Danish Financial Statements Act (Årsregnskabsloven)

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems, preferably e-conomic

• Solid understanding of balance sheet accounting, revenue recognition, capitalised development costs, accruals and intercompany transactions.

• Experience with project controlling – budgets, work in progress, utilisation and project margin follow-up – ideally in a consultancy, engineering, Trading or EPC business.

• A genuine AI-first way of working: you use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot daily and can show concrete examples of finance processes you have automated (e.g. with Python, SQL, Power Query, APIs or low-code tools).

• Strong Excel and financial modelling skills combined with a structured, control-minded approach and high attention to detail.

• The ability to work independently in a fast-paced scale-up, prioritise under pressure and explain financial matters clearly to non-finance colleagues.

• Language: English (required); Danish

_Nice to have

_

• Experience from energy trading, utilities, commodities or financial services – e.g. settlement, collateral, imbalance or margin processes.

• Experience with e-conomic, time registration or PSA tools, ERP migration to a more scalable platform, and BI tools such as Power BI.

• Experience with public grant-funded projects, transfer pricing or building internal controls in a growth company.

• A background from a Big 4 or mid-tier audit firm.

**What we offer

**

• Real responsibility: the chance to improve how close, controls and reporting are run in a scaling energy trading group – not just maintain them.

• An AI-first workplace where you get the tools and the mandate to automate, experiment and rethink how finance is done, working closely with our CFO, trading and tech teams with exposure to board and investor reporting.

• Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.

• A collaborative environment with short decision lines, high trust, and strong cross-functional execution.

• The opportunity to work with forward-looking customers and partners driving electrification and the green transition in Northern Europe.

Ready to apply?

Ready to build an AI-first finance function for a company where every megawatt-hour traded must be settled, reconciled and controlled? If you combine accounting rigour with a builder's mindset, we would love to hear from you.

Deadline

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until 10 December. We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if a suitable candidate is identified and accepted.

jobs.occupation: QEHS Manager wanted for Belden Cekan
jobs.description:

And do you want to help lift our certifications, EHS programs and environmental initiatives in an international manufacturing company? Then you might be our new QEHS Manager.

We are looking for a committed colleague for our factory in Gjern, Central Jutland. This is a role where you will be a central focal point between production, R&D, management and the rest of the organisation when it comes to ensuring high standards and continuous improvements.

As a QEHS Manager you will work as part of a matrix organisation, reporting directly to the factory manager on-site and to the Q and EHS Managers EMEA respectively in a dotted line. This position makes you part of the management team and has one direct report.

You will make a difference in the following ways

• Developing, evaluating, improving and implementing a new integrated management system at Belden Cekan.

• Securing necessary certifications such as ISO 9001:2008, ISO 14001 and upcoming projects such as ISO 45001 in collaboration with external authorities.

• Conducting internal audits and supplier audits to ensure compliance with standards.

• Handling complaints and collaborating with R&D and production management on corrective actions.

• Supporting production by monitoring and auditing quality systems and initiating improvement initiatives.

• Responsibility for the Quality Room, including layout, equipment and procedures.

• Planning and execution of calibration programs and archiving systems for product specifications.

• Participation in the health and safety committee and lean projects for continuous improvement.

• Responsibility for reporting ESG data as well as quality and safety to the remaining group.

We are looking for a candidate who can combine structure with impact while thriving on working close to both people and processes. You have an eye for detail, but can also lift your gaze and see connections across the board.

You might be an ideal fit if you:

• Have experience with quality, safety and environmental management, preferably from a manufacturing company.

• Are certified or have solid knowledge of ISO standards.

• Are fluent in English, both orally and in writing.

• Have strong communication and collaboration skills across departments and countries.

• Work in a structured, analytical and proactive manner with problem solving and improvements.

What we can offer you

You will have a key position in an international company with strong values, where quality, employee safety and environmental responsibility are prioritized as essential parts of running a factory. • A collaborative environment with a focus on continuous improvement.

Send your application and CV as soon as possible by clicking 'Apply'. We process applications on an ongoing basis. For more information about us, visit our website at www.belden.com. We look forward to hearing from you!

Do you have any questions? Contact Factory Manager Kim Fredriksen on tel. 93636200.

About Belden Cekan A/S

Since 1979, we have developed and manufactured network connectors and special machines. We are approximately 40 employees and have been Great Place to Work certified since 2021. We are part of Belden Inc., a global group with over 8,000 employees.

Do you want to head up quality and food safety at Harboe’s production site in Skælskør? Do you possess a strong professional background within QA/QC, and are you motivated by driving a proactive quality culture in close collaboration with production? Then you might be the one we are looking for.

About us

Harboes Bryggeri produces and sells beer, soft drinks, and malt- and fruit-based ingredients and beverages. Production takes place at our breweries in Skælskør and at the fully owned Darguner Brauerei in Germany. Both sites produce and package beverages in glass, cans, and PET, while Dargun also handles draught beer. Malt-based ingredients and concentrates are produced in Skælskør.

Quality and food safety are fundamental to everything we do. The Quality Department plays a key role in ensuring compliance, maintaining high standards, and safeguarding product quality from raw material to finished goods.

The position and Key responsibilities

As Quality Manager, you will have overall responsibility for leading Harboe’s Quality Department and ensuring the effective operation, maintenance, and continuous alignment of our quality management system.

You will become a part of the Group Quality Team and report directly to the Plant Director in Skælskør, with a dotted line reference to the Director, R&D, ESG and Quality.

Your primary focus will be to lead and develop our QA and QC teams while ensuring that our quality and food safety standards are consistently implemented and maintained across the organisation. Through visible leadership and close collaboration with production and other key stakeholders, you will ensure that quality remains an integral part of daily operations.

Building on our existing quality management system, you will drive systematic and continuous quality improvements. The role covers in-house products, ingredients, raw materials, packaging materials, and quality-related activities throughout production. You will ensure compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements while ensuring that the quality function supports customer expectations and operational needs.

Main focus areas include:

• Leading and developing the Quality Department, including QA and QC teams, ensuring clear priorities, strong collaboration, and a high level of engagement.

• Ensuring effective implementation and maintenance of the quality management system (IPW), including compliance with standards such as IFS and FSSC 22000.

• Planning, conducting, and following up on internal and external audits, including training of the internal audit team in Skælskør.

• Maintaining close cooperation with production, including handling of deviations, root cause analysis, and follow-up on corrective actions.

• Ensuring professional handling of customer complaints, including documentation, investigation, and timely follow-up.

• Ensuring compliance with food legislation, regulatory requirements, and quality standards, including communication and documentation.

• Supporting supplier quality requirements, including hygiene standards and HACCP-based controls through training and monitoring.

"In Skælskør, we believe that world-class quality is built right on the production floor through strong relationships, transparency, and a shared mindset. As our new Quality Manager, you will not just be managing systems and compliance from an office—you will be a visible and motivating partner directly in our operations. If you are ready to take true ownership, inspire your team, and bridge the gap between regulatory standards and daily production practices, we can’t wait to welcome you on board."

– Plant Director, Mogens Auchenberg

About you

You are a strong and present leader with solid experience from QA/QC in a food or similar regulated industry (e.g. ingredients or pharma). You have hands-on experience with HACCP, GMP, and certifications such as IFS and FSSC 22000, and you are familiar with food legislation and regulatory requirements across markets.

You work in a structured and analytical way and are known for being proactive, resilient, and communicative. You are able to motivate and engage others and have a strong focus on collaboration and operational execution.

You ideally hold a relevant degree within Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering, or a similar field.

Interested?

If you would like to learn more about the position, please feel free to contact Plant Director, Mogens Auchenberg at mau@harboe.com.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, CV, and any relevant supporting documents.

The first round of interviews will take place on 7 December 2026, followed by a second round on 14 December 2026. We kindly ask applicants to keep these dates available.

Harboes Bryggeri views diversity as a strength and encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Software Developer – Team Box Collab
jobs.description:
Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help modernize a product area at the heart of construction projects.

Dalux is growing, and we are looking for an experienced software developer to join our Box Collab team.

You will build software in our File Management product (Box) that enables communication and collaboration across construction stakeholders—for example, file comments, sharing, versioning, and review. This domain is widely used and deeply integrated across the Dalux product suite, so reliability, performance, and strong technical design are essential. In Box Collab, we foster an engaging, enjoyable work environment where people take ownership and accountability for outcomes. You’ll join a young, skilled team with strong opportunities to influence both product evolution and architectural direction.

**Your role

**As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will join a full-stack development team working closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks: helping make good technical decisions, improving the codebase and architecture, sharing knowledge, and raising the engineering standard around them.

Within Box Collab, there is a particular focus on strengthening and evolving the technical foundation of the product while continuing to deliver new functionality.

Your work can include:

• Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end

• Designing and implementing scalable, maintainable solutions

• Contributing to architectural decisions and the technical direction of Box Collab.

• Improving the structure of an established codebase and reducing technical debt

• Helping evolve boundaries and modularity within the application

• Sparring with and mentoring other developers

• Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions

• Bringing new ideas, technologies, and development practices into the team when they create real value

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

**AI-assisted software development

**We are significantly increasing our focus on AI-assisted development across Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can improve the software development lifecycle – from understanding requirements and exploring technical approaches to coding, testing, review, debugging, refactoring, and automation.

The Box Collab team is already experimenting with how these tools can improve its day-to-day development work.

As an experienced developer, we want you to take an active role in that development: experimenting with new workflows, critically evaluating their value, sharing what works, and helping establish good engineering practices around AI-assisted development.

• MSSQL

• Experience improving or modernizing established software systems

• Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools and workflows

Technical judgment, curiosity, and the ability to make an established product better are more important than having worked with exactly the same technologies or architectural patterns before.

**Product development at Dalux

**Our product teams bring developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers together.

Developers are expected to understand the problem being solved and contribute to finding the solution – not simply implement specifications handed to them.

As an experienced developer, you will have an important voice in balancing user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

**What You Can Expect From Dalux

**Dalux is a software company at heart.

As an experienced developer, you can expect:

• Significant ownership of the software you build

• Real influence on technical solutions and engineering practices

• Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge

• Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design

• Short paths from technical ideas to decisions and implementation

• Opportunities to improve an established product and architecture

• An environment actively investing in AI-assisted software development

• High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.
